notes.text: Own PLACED + exact open OFFERED: atomic offer DECLINED + Order REJECTED + closed_at / reason. COD VOIDED; ONLINE REFUND_PENDING, refund_amount=C (BR-17; SUC03-PC04). Stale / denied: no changes. Busy / write / COMMIT failure: rollback all (UC05-MG01).
Persistence: loaded/saved through data access — see 4.3.2.

continuation: Complete design operation; failure path is the alternative operand above.
realisation_note: Guard: active own Customer; PLACED; exact open OFFERED with matching order/offer IDs. SUC03-PC04: atomic REJECTED + closed_at / reason; COD VOIDED; ONLINE REFUND_PENDING, refund_amount=C replaces any partial owed amount. No payout. Open offer DECLINED; helpers are real module functions. Rowcount, busy and failure-through-COMMIT rollback†. Root-adopted P4-TARGET: release_payment persists the full-C refund amount together with state and checks every conditional save in the same transaction (F-02; P2-S01; P3-S03).
refresh_policy: Explicit shared-model statuses only; matching signatures never clear behavioral targets.
